summary: Iteration 50 — working-draft inline comments. Backend: 36 pytest cases across GET/POST/resolve/DELETE comment endpoints + comment_stats on the WD list + WD-cycle scoping — 36/36 passing. Frontend: BLOCKER found first — the whole webpack build was failing (RangeError: Maximum call stack size exceeded in babel-loader on CounselConsole.jsx), so the entire app rendered only the CRA error overlay. Root-caused to the @emergentbase/visual-edits babel plugin choking on the direct JSX self-recursion in CommentCard (<CommentCard/> rendered inside CommentCard); reproduced with a 15-line minimal file. Applied a behaviour-preserving 2-line alias workaround so the build compiles, then completed full UI testing: badge, diff header count, line-hover + button, inline compose/post, threaded reply, resolve/reopen, general panel, and admin-vs-counsel delete permissions all work. One CRITICAL UI defect remains: 76 stray compose forms render as soon as the diff modal opens.

minor.issue: line_number is coerced with int() so a float like 1.9 silently becomes line 1 (truncation). Non-numeric/0/-1 correctly become general. Cosmetic only.

ui_bugs.issue: CRITICAL: compose form leaks onto every removed-only row. Condition is `composeLine === row.rightNum`; removed rows have rightNum === null and the initial composeLine state is null, so null === null is true. Measured 76 open compose forms (placeholder 'Ask a question about line null…') the instant the modal opens on 03-cookie-notice — the diff is unreadable. Also produces 76 duplicate data-testid='diff-compose-line-null-textarea' nodes, and because they all bind the single `composeBody` state, typing in one mirrors the text into all 76 (verified). Fix: render the compose row only when `composeLine != null && composeLine === row.rightNum`.

CRITICAL (fixed by testing agent): direct JSX self-recursion (<CommentCard/> inside CommentCard for replies) crashes the @emergentbase/visual-edits babel plugin => 'Module build failed … RangeError: Maximum call stack size exceeded' => whole frontend served the CRA error overlay (every route dead). I added `const NestedCard = CommentCard;` and render <NestedCard/> which breaks the plugin's cycle and compiles. Please review/keep this pattern (or split replies into a dedicated component) and never reintroduce direct self-recursive JSX.

Badge is gated on `wd?.comment_stats?.open > 0`, so a working draft with 2 comments where both are resolved shows no badge at all even though total>0. Spec asked for an open/total badge; consider rendering when total>0 (e.g. '0 open · 2 total').

Line-anchored comment threads and the per-line '+' buttons are only rendered in side-by-side mode. In unified mode only general comments are visible (verified: 1 card visible vs 4 line-anchored existing), with no hint that line comments exist.

`composeBody` is a single shared state used by the line compose form AND the general compose form, so a half-typed line comment appears inside the general compose box (and vice versa). Should be per-form state.

issues: The 76 stray compose forms push the actual diff rows far apart — the modal is effectively unusable until the leak is fixed
Hover '+' button uses opacity-0/group-hover (opacity 0 -> 1 confirmed working), but it is only 16px and overlaps the gutter number; fine but tight

action_items: FIX (critical): gate the inline compose row on `composeLine != null && composeLine === row.rightNum` in CounselConsole.jsx DiffModal so removed-only rows stop rendering compose forms.
Give line compose and general compose their own state (or key composeBody by target) to stop text mirroring.
Keep the non-self-recursive CommentCard pattern (alias NestedCard) — direct self-recursive JSX breaks the visual-edits babel plugin and kills the whole webpack build.
Render the /counsel comments badge whenever comment_stats.total > 0 (currently hidden when open === 0).
Consider rendering line-anchored threads (or at least a count) in unified diff mode.
CounselConsole.jsx is now 1174 lines — split DiffModal / comment components into their own files per the >700-line guideline.
critical_code_review_comments: DiffModal: `{composeLine === row.rightNum && …}` is a null-equality bug — both sides are null for removed rows and on first render.
Duplicate data-testid values (diff-compose-line-null-textarea x76) break test-id uniqueness; testids must be unique per rendered node.

Backend delete cascade only removes depth-1 replies ($or id/parent_id). Reply-to-a-reply is possible via the API (parent_id can point at a reply), which would orphan grandchildren — the UI only ever nests one level, but the API allows deeper threads.
GET /working-drafts/{slug}/comments returns [] (not 404) when no open WD — intentional per docstring, verified.
list_working_drafts comment_stats uses one aggregate pipeline (good, no N+1) and _id is excluded everywhere — verified no _id leakage in comment payloads.

rca_of_the_issue: 1) Build blocker: @emergentbase/visual-edits babel plugin recurses infinitely when a component's JSX references the component itself (minimal repro: a 15-line CommentCard rendering <CommentCard/>), producing 'RangeError: Maximum call stack size exceeded' from babel-loader; plain babel-preset-react-app (+react-refresh) compiles the same file fine, which isolates the plugin. Aliasing the component (const NestedCard = CommentCard) breaks the traversal cycle. 2) Stray compose forms: DiffModal keeps a single `composeLine` initialised to null and renders the compose row when `composeLine === row.rightNum`; every removed-only diff row carries rightNum === null, so the guard is true for all of them on first render.
